entity.name: Diagram Chasing
entity.description: Diagram Chasing is an independent data journalism and visualisation collective based in India. We build interactive stories, maps, and explorables that make public data legible and meaningful — covering elections, urban infrastructure, climate, policy, and everyday Indian life.

projects.name: Diagram Chasing
projects.description: An independent data journalism and visualisation studio. We produce open, interactive data stories on topics like elections, urban mobility, climate risk, and public health in India. All published work is freely accessible and our code is open source.

channels.description: Direct bank transfer (UPI / NEFT / IMPS). Please email aman@diagramchasing.fun to receive payment details.

plans.name: Research & Development
plans.description: Funds independent R&D; new tools, datasets, and experimental formats that underpin our published work.

plans.name: Commissioning
plans.description: Supports commissioning contributors such as writers, designers, and developers to produce data stories and explorables.

plans.name: Events
plans.description: Covers costs for public events, workshops, and community gatherings around data, journalism, and civic technology.

plans.name: General support
plans.description: Any amount helps! Please contribute what you can to keep our independent work going
